title: K-flat complex of modules on a ringed site
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site and $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings on $\mathcal C$. A cochain complex $\mathcal F^\bullet$ of sheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules is *acyclic* if all its cohomology sheaves vanish (cohomology in the abelian category of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]). A cochain complex $\mathcal K^\bullet$ of sheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules is *K-flat* if for every acyclic complex $\mathcal F^\bullet$ of $\mathcal O$-modules the total tensor complex $\operatorname{Tot}(\mathcal F^\bullet\otimes_{\mathcal O}\mathcal K^\bullet)$ [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] is acyclic. A *K-flat resolution* of a complex $\mathcal G^\bullet$ is a quasi-isomorphism $\mathcal K^\bullet\to\mathcal G^\bullet$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] with $\mathcal K^\bullet$ K-flat.
